name: beta-core ROS2 Jazzy
postCreateCommand:
sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -q python3-colcon-common-extensions python3-colcon-mixin python3-rosdep python3-vcstool ros-jazzy-rmw-cyclonedds-cpp && python3 -m pip install --user pre-commit && sudo rosdep init 2>/dev/null || true && rosdep update && colcon mixin add default https://raw.githubusercontent.com/colcon/colcon-mixin-repository/master/index.yaml && colcon mixin update default && mkdir -p /ros2_ws/src && ln -sfn ${containerWorkspaceFolder} /ros2_ws/src/beta-core && mkdir -p ~/.colcon && printf 'build:
  symlink-install: true
  cmake-args:
    - -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo
test:
  return-code-on-test-failure: true
' > ~/.colcon/defaults.yaml && source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && cd /ros2_ws && rosdep install --from-paths src --ignore-src -r -y 2>/dev/null || true
